entities.name: UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to establish a PDU session. UE provides 3GPP PS data off UE status in Extended protocol configuration options IE during this procedure.

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to modify an existing PDU session. Used to indicate changes in 3GPP PS data off UE status.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options IE
entities.description: Information element used to carry 3GPP PS data off UE status during PDU session establishment and modification procedures.

entities.name: 3GPP PS data off UE status activated
entities.description: State where UE restricts uplink data transmission via 3GPP access except for exempt services.

entities.name: 3GPP PS data off exempt services list for HPLMN/EHPLMN
entities.description: Configured list of services exempt from PS data off restrictions when UE is in HPLMN or EHPLMN.

entities.name: 3GPP PS data off exempt services list for VPLMN
entities.description: Configured list of services exempt from PS data off restrictions when UE is in VPLMN.

entities.name: 3GPP PS data off exempt services list for subscribed SNPN
entities.description: Configured list of services exempt from PS data off restrictions when UE is in subscribed SNPN.

entities.name: 3GPP PS data off exempt services list for non-subscribed SNPN
entities.description: Configured list of services exempt from PS data off restrictions when UE is in non-subscribed SNPN.

entities.name: 3GPP PS data off UE status changed since last providing
entities.description: Condition where UE's PS data off status has changed since last reported to network.

entities.name: Restrict uplink data transmission
entities.description: UE behavior to restrict uplink IP, Ethernet, and Unstructured user data packets via 3GPP access when PS data off is activated.

relations.description: UE provides 3GPP PS data off UE status in Extended protocol configuration options IE during PDU session establishment
UE provides 3GPP PS data off UE status in Extended protocol configuration options IE during PDU session modification
UE must provide PS data off status in Extended PCO IE if the status has changed since last providing
When PS data off status is activated, UE restricts uplink data transmission via 3GPP access
Uplink restriction does not apply to services in HPLMN/EHPLMN exempt list
Uplink restriction does not apply to services in VPLMN exempt list
Uplink restriction does not apply to services in subscribed SNPN exempt list
Uplink restriction does not apply to services in non-subscribed SNPN exempt list
UE uses PDU session modification procedure to indicate changes in PS data off status
